t: Pack of 2 Magnusson ratchet clamps featuring carbon steel bars for strength and durability. Provides maximum gripping strength for one-handed use. Also includes quick-release trigger for rapid adjustments and ease of use, full-face pads for even pressure distribution, and soft plastic protective jaw guards to help prevent damage to surfaces. Fast tool-free change from clamp to spreader. Constructed from nylon and thermoplastic rubber.
